final_answer:
5 results for 'Does Atlas run on Windows':
1. https://wiki.example/atlas/faq - Atlas FAQ
   Q: Does Atlas run on Windows? A: No. Atlas supports Linux and macOS only.
2. https://atlas.example/docs/install - Installing Atlas
   Atlas requires Python 3.11 or newer and runs on Linux and macOS.
3. https://atlas.example/ - Atlas - internal deployment tool
   Atlas is the internal deployment tool for the Atlas rollout.
4. https://atlas.example/blog/2026-03-release-1-2 - Atlas 1.2.0 released
   Atlas 1.2.0 adds export to CSV and Parquet and raises the webhook retry limit to 8.
5. https://atlas.example/docs - Atlas documentation
   Guides for installing, configuring and operating Atlas.
